entities.name: Oxylabs
entities.how_described: 嘉宾所在公司:过去十年帮训练大语言模型的公司获取数据,现在用同一套抓取基础设施帮 AI 智能体大规模、低成本地访问网络;本集演示了它的 Fast Search API、Web Scraper API 和无头浏览器。

evidence.quote: I work for Oxylabs, where in the past 10 years we've helped companies that trained large language models get their data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 网页抓取 (web scraping)
entities.how_described: 本集称之为智能体缺失的基础设施层,并提炼抓取行业三条老原则:只有绝对必要时才用浏览器、先验证内容(HTTP 200 不等于有效内容)、内容越轻量越好。

evidence.quote: Today I'm going to talk a lot about missing layer of agentic AI and explain a little bit about how web scraping infrastructure can actually help you.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And boom, we have an agent that commands a powerful infrastructure hardened by years of web scraping experience.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 浏览器自动化 (browser automation)
entities.how_described: 朋友最初全流程都用浏览器自动化框架,结果是又慢又贵又不可靠;本集主张它是最后手段,只在填表单、交互性强的购买环节才真正需要。

evidence.quote: He was using a browser automation framework for everything, and it was slow.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: He used the browser automation tool for that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Their browser automation tool lacked what we call stealth, so they would get captures and sometimes fail to access the sites altogether.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 验证码 (CAPTCHA)
entities.how_described: 朋友搭建的智能体一路被验证码拦截导致流程崩溃;本集指出多数客户检测不到这种失败,把验证码页当有效内容喂给模型是白白浪费 token。

evidence.quote: Now, a large language model, of course, can distinguish between valid eShop content and a CAPTCHA, but we need to spend tokens in order to do that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 大语言模型 (large language model)
entities.how_described: 本集强调要先验证内容再喂给大语言模型:开 10 个网站只有 3 个有效却全喂进去,等于浪费 70% 的 token;模型虽能分辨验证码,但分辨本身要花 token。

evidence.quote: Now, a large language model, of course, can distinguish between valid eShop content and a CAPTCHA, but we need to spend tokens in order to do that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In case of CAPTCHAs or other blocks, the request would fail with an explicit error message, so I know not to include it when sending to a large language model.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We both used Playwright MCP with a browser and a large language model.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: token
entities.how_described: 本集反复以 token 成本论证抓取原则的价值:Fast Search API 响应不到 2,000 个 token、Web Scraper API 只返回有效内容,都是为了减少 token 浪费、让成本可预测。

evidence.quote: Not only does it open up the web, but also saves the time on implementation and token cost.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Fast Search API
entities.how_described: Oxylabs 专为智能体打造的搜索产品:返回紧凑 JSON(每次不到 2,000 token)、平均响应不到 700 毫秒、价格低且可预测,让智能体用搜索引擎索引替代用浏览器逐站翻找。

evidence.quote: That is why I chose to use a product that we built, especially for agents, Fast Search API.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So in the discovery phase, instead of predefined list and the browser, we give agent a tool to search the web, fast search API.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Web Scraper API
entities.how_described: Oxylabs 的轻量 REST 抓取接口:只返回有效内容、失败时带明确错误信息、支持 Markdown 输出与地理定位、可并行数百请求,且只为成功结果付费——「不治愈,不收费」。

evidence.quote: So I tried to rebuild the stage without a browser, only by using Oxlabs Web Scraper API.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Playwright MCP
entities.how_described: 本集购买阶段使用的让大模型操控浏览器的工具协议,配合浏览器加大模型;换成 Oxylabs 无头浏览器后即为即插即用替换,解决了访问被验证码拦的问题。

evidence.quote: We both used Playwright MCP with a browser and a large language model.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 无头浏览器 (headless browser)
entities.how_described: Oxylabs 的不带界面的后台浏览器,对 Playwright MCP 即插即用;带浏览器源码级隐身处理、开箱即用的住宅代理和地理定位能力。

evidence.quote: I just connected the Oxlabs headless browser since it supports player at MCP is just a drop-in replacement.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 地理定位 (geolocation)
entities.how_described: 本集强调地理定位要贯穿全流程:很多电商按用户位置显示库存和尺码,发现、验证、购买三环节用同一套地理定位,否则结账时才发现缺货。

evidence.quote: And finally, it supports geolocation options so I can localize my results and get relevant content.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Most importantly, in this case, a geolocation capability.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 可观测性 (observability)
entities.how_described: 本集提到朋友因可观测性做得好才发现了验证码失败,而多数客户只查状态码和内容大小、检测不到失败。

evidence.quote: It's a good thing he did well with observability, so he actually noticed when it happened.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
